Chronograph Calibre

Architectural Purity

A contemporary interpretation of the haute horlogerie chronograph, combining nanometer precision engineering with architectural purity. Designed to measure fleeting moments with absolute clarity.

Automatic Movement

Continuous Power

Powered by the in-house Calibre AEON 60-P, delivering 28,800 vibrations per hour and a 72-hour power reserve, visible in high relief through the double sapphire crystal architecture.

Case & Finishes

Hand-Polished Chamfers

Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the 60mm case alternates between hand-polished chamfers and satin-brushed flank surfaces, creating subtle reflections that sculpt light.

Dial & Complications

Tiered Guilloché Depth

The dial reveals a multi-tiered architecture with Côtes de Genève micro-grooves, recessed chronograph counters, and faceted rhodium-plated indices that deliver exceptional legibility.

AEON 60P

Self-Winding System

Kinetic Tungsten Rotor

A bidirectional tungsten oscillating weight captures kinetic energy from every wrist motion, transferring power effortlessly into the twin mainspring barrel.

Extreme Reliability

38 Synthetic Rubies

Engineered with 38 synthetic ruby bearings and an anti-magnetic Glucydur balance spring to maintain chronometric certification under all conditions.

Refined Dial

A multi-layered architectural sunray dial engineered for instant readability, balanced symmetry, and timeless horological appeal.

Polished Hands

Diamond-cut dauphine hands with Super-LumiNova luminescence glide with fluid continuous motion across the dial surface.

Premium Bezel

A solid beveled bezel with micro-fluted rim adds structural depth, catching ambient light to accentuate the watch profile.
